# FlameFix Gas Services

FlameFix offers professional doorstep repair and maintenance for gas stoves, built-in hobs, cooktops, burners, cooking ranges, and commercial gas appliances. We serve your city and nearby areas with same-day appointments available from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

## Services

- Gas stove repair (all burner types, ignition, valves)
- Built-in hob service (glass top, induction-adjacent, modular)
- Gas cooktop repair (domestic and commercial)
- Cooking range service (multi-burner, oven combinations)
- Commercial appliance maintenance (restaurants, hotels)
- Safety inspections and gas leak checks

## Booking

Use the booking form on the homepage or contact page to submit an appliance issue. You will receive confirmation via WhatsApp. No payment is collected through the form — inspection charges are confirmed before the visit.
